heard_on_the_hill.headline: Moolenaar seeks review of Hong Kong's Fed liquidity access
heard_on_the_hill.body: House Select Committee on the CCP Chairman John Moolenaar called for a review of Hong Kong's access to a Federal Reserve liquidity facility, a request CNBC set against China's promotion of the renminbi as a global reserve currency.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: Select Committee faults Webull over China links
heard_on_the_hill.body: A bipartisan Select Committee on China investigation led by Chairman John Moolenaar and Ranking Member Ro Khanna found that brokerage Webull Financial "has not been transparent about its links to China." Webull shares fell after the committee flagged the ties, Reuters reported.

research.lead: Jose M. Macias III, Tao-Hung Chang, Nico Vacca, Benjamin Jensen
research.title: China’s Weaponization of Dual-Use Research Vessels for Undersea Data Dominance
research.line: Analyzing 223 vessels, finds Chinese research ships spend an unusually large share of time near subsea infrastructure on the high seas.

research.title: Learning Without Bleeding: China’s Lessons from the Russia-Ukraine Drone War
research.line: Traces how quickly Chinese analysts identify battlefield innovations and how the PLA turns them into training, procurement, hardware and force structure.

research.title: Russia’s Turn to China Under Sanctions: Sanctions Decay, Substitution Elasticity, and the Challenge of Sustaining Pressure
research.line: Argues sanctions lose force when targeted actors replace restricted products, suppliers and acquisition channels faster than controls adapt.

research.lead: Lauren Mai, Andreyka Natalegawa, Gregory B. Poling, Japhet Quitzon
research.title: Understanding the Chinese-Language Media Landscape in Southeast Asia
research.line: Argues countering Chinese information warfare requires buy-in from regional partners and awareness of Chinese-language media's reach in Southeast Asia.

research.title: The AI Export Dilemma
research.line: Weighs whether the United States should allow AI technology exports and how it could stay ahead in the global technology race.
